evidence_items.explanation: This supports the first part. The leading LLM generates text by predicting likely next tokens. The report also notes post-training, which shapes but does not replace that process.

receipt.public_excerpt: When you click on the “G” icon, Bard will read the response and evaluate whether there is content across the web to substantiate it.

evidence_items.explanation: From September 2023, Google's deployed LLM product, at the user's request, checked its own answers against web content. This contradicts 'NEVER fact-check' as applied to LLM products.

receipt.public_excerpt: the model first (i) drafts an initial response; then (ii) plans verification questions to fact-check its draft;

evidence_items.explanation: Before the post, LLMs were shown fact-checking their own drafts when prompted. This contradicts the universal 'NEVER'.

unresolved_gaps: By default, a bare LLM does not fact-check unless prompted or given tools. The 'never' part turns on whether prompted or tool-assisted checking counts.
